items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: did you ever play with Jimmy Noon at any? just on gigs yeah just gigging around you see and I played with him out there

ctx.x: with a rivalry between Martin Paley and Joe Glaser it was Martin Paley who was the manager of the Sunset of the plantation after yeah but the man who had the bakery and bakery was the one who paid his soul so was Jimmy Noon at the apex in those days that's right Jimmy Noon was right down 35th he was upstairs in 8 books and that's where Albert Nicholas and Bonnie Beagle would go up there every night to come up the plantation to hear Jimmy Noon playing and that's what Jimmy Noon was the cause of Bonnie picking up…
I remember he played sax when he left for Jarlene
